preparationFailuresPreserved: Initial graph idle query was denied by sandbox; retried with process inventory permission before any compression.
Two read-cache preparation attempts stopped before any mutation because the old Docker summary used a mapping and lowercase summary fields; corrected from actual structure.
First whole check could not open its local HTTP listener in sandbox; same check passed with permission.
First parser contracts used default Go cache; reran with approved explicit cache.
limitations: The native storage proof uses real Linux fixture files and refusal canaries, not blockchain functional acceptance.
Seven successful retentions and six refusals preserve source and helper inputs; 71 archive entries, 70 local files and two canaries were independently compared.
Idle owned fifteen fixtures were stopped with configurations preserved; one owned fixture was subsequently started for this proof. Three original fixtures stayed stopped.
Old receipt gaps, full L1, actual external network inputs, W3/W4 and final Web acceptance remain open.
